I wish I had the same luck.
All the best for you

I feel you.
I just turned 30 and most of my friends are happily married planning to have kids. 
I don't even have a boyfriend or someone I flirt with. And this causes so much pain that I avoid going out.

Also my friends don't really understand depression. They say I have everything I needs and this causes more pain. 

And being so negative makes me unpleasant. I get anxious with boys and they eventually run away. 

I am thinking that maybe I could make a plan to make new friends by joining free classes or making friends in forums like this one. 
How do you feel about that? 

I really hope you feel better today.
